items.text: Las Vegas (TBD): CB Darien Porter (groin). On IR: DE Patrick Johnson, TE Carter Runyon.

San Francisco (TBD): RB Christian McCaffrey (mild hamstring), WR Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis) and WR Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) eyeing Sunday returns, DE Nick Bosa (knee/calf, missed five games), CB Upton Stout (AC joint). WR Demarcus Robinson eyeing return from IR; WR Ricky Pearsall out for season; DT DeForest Buckner acquired from IND.
